entities.name: Aryl acid to alcohol
observations: The encoded change replaces a carboxylic-acid group, Ar-C(=O)O, with the corresponding primary alcohol, Ar-CH2OH.
The aryl bromide and aryl fluoride substituents are intended to remain unchanged.

entities.name: Borane acid reduction
observations: Borane complexes such as BH3·THF or BH3·SMe2 are standard reagents for reducing carboxylic acids to primary alcohols.
Borane is often preferred when preserving aryl halides is important, subject to substrate-specific compatibility.

entities.name: Lithium aluminium hydride reduction
observations: LiAlH4 reduces carboxylic acids to primary alcohols under anhydrous ether or THF conditions followed by aqueous workup.
LiAlH4 is powerful and may reduce or affect other reducible functional groups, so it is a less chemoselective fallback.

entities.name: NaBH4 iodine acid reduction
observations: NaBH4 with iodine or related activation systems can reduce carboxylic acids to primary alcohols in selected substrates.
This option is generally more substrate- and condition-dependent than borane or LiAlH4.
